title: VE/TS Vegetables L1-L3 ordinary assessment translation candidates
mode: read-only machine-draft proposals; no repository edits or fluent/local farming approval

authority.sourceAuthority: Canonical quiz objects from COURSE_MODULES; current target text obtained by calling resolveLearnerLessonPresentation on the registered VE and TS lesson drafts.

precisionRules: Retain canonical crops/species, maize/bean/pumpkin/lettuce/pepper/tomato/brassica/Amadumbe, KZN and all numerical values.
Retain genetics terms: open-pollinated, hybrid, breed true, F1, pollination, and managed pollination where a verified equivalent is unavailable.
Retain nitrogen-fixation, root-bacteria, bean-residue and decomposition claims exactly; translate ordinary question/option framing around those technical clauses.
Retain wet-ground/damper-ground suitability and maize comparison; translate ordinary narrative around it without changing crop adaptation.
Retain compaction, transplant shock, root disturbance, drainage and pest pressure where local precision is uncertain.
Preserve negation, “only”, “always”, “never”, “immediately”, timing, quantities, answer indices, and distractor claims.
Do not infer a pesticide instruction; pesticide terms are outside these L1-L3 assessment rows.

proposedQuiz.q: Ndi ngani ni tshi vhulunga bed ya miroho i na vhuphara ha 1-1.2m, nṱhani ha u i ita yo aṱamaho?

Ni nga swikelela vhukati ni tshi bva kha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa masia mavhili ni sa kande fhethu hune zwimela zwa mela, na thivhela compaction.

Ndi mulayo wo vhewaho une wa si vha na tshiitisi tsha u shumisa.
proposedQuiz.rationale: U kanda fhethu hune zwimela zwa mela zwi ita compaction na u tshinyadza midzi — bed ya miroho ine na nga swikelela vhukati hwayo ni tshi bva masia oṱhe mavhili i amba uri ni nga si vhuye na tea u kanda fhethu hune zwimela zwa mela.

proposedQuiz.q: Ndi tshimela tshifhio tshine tsha fanelea vhukuma u itela direct-seeding u fhira transplanting?

Brassicas, dzine dza ṱoḓa tsireledzo musi dzi tshee ṱhukhu
